secrets_substrate.non_claim: No raw tax authority credential, API key, bearer token, certificate private key, provider credential, or tenant tax payload is introduced or consumed by this local foundation.

mesh_layering.non_claim: No live Cloud Billing Tax pod, service mesh policy, tax authority network path, or e-invoicing clearance endpoint is deployed by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

tax_foundation.non_claim: Rust app/domain surfaces validate request metadata and expected tax invoice format labels only. They do not calculate statutory tax, file returns, clear invoices, call government APIs, or persist tax ledgers.

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001 is metadata/app validation only. Runtime tax calculation, government clearance, databases, capacity telemetry, autoscaling, and SLOs remain explicit non-claims.

sharding_automation.non_claim: No ledger shard split, billing/tax worker migration, tenant migration, or audit-chain persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

dr.non_claim: No live billing ledger replication, tax catalog replication, warm standby, failover, restore drill, or DR measurement evidence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: Cloud Billing Tax is intended Tier-2 first-party financial/compliance application workload. CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001 has no runtime pod deployment; tier is retained as intended future isolation class only.

tenant_version_pinning.non_claim: Root invoice OpenAPI is code-tested for current app boundary behavior, but no per-tenant API version pinning runtime is implemented by CS-CLOUD-BILLING-TAX-001.

explicit_non_claims: No live tax calculation engine, statutory rate catalog, tax authority integration, e-invoice clearance, exemption certificate validation, filing artifact generation, database, REST server, SDK, worker, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, measured SLO, capacity telemetry, DR, or audit-chain runtime persistence is implemented.
